summary: The builder script reproduces move-turn.json byte-identically, the stored cone-chain numbers replay exactly, and my own probes (sphere, cylinder, hole-box, spin-built, ring chains of 6-24 steps) found no silent wrong solid through the guard translator. Remaining gaps are one major interpreter silent-accept row (honestly marked unsupported) and un-fuzzed non-cone chain classes.

replays.stored: shipped FAIL dCom 3.02e-5; guard refused Move 3 by limit
guard PASS control, shipped refuses copy

replays.live: 9 PASS, 1 flagged by relative bbox metric only (abs 2.07e-3 mm on 44 mm part, dCom 1.5e-5, dVol 1.6e-4): tessellation, not wrong

defects.problem: Builds a plain consuming move with no sentence, so the student asked for a copy and the original silently vanishes. Row is honestly 'unsupported' but no refusal fires; interpreter in packages/script is not fixed.

Support depends on guard in move-turn-harness/translate-guard.mjs (invariant, repair, 3-step cone limit) which is not in the shipped translator; the limit 3 was fitted after seeing failures. Rows state this.

defects.feature: chains of spin-built parts and rings
defects.problem: Cone-chain fuzz covers cone/copies/join/control (box, cylinder, prism, wedge, sphere) only; spin-built non-cone parts and rings are not in the stored fuzz. My 10-chain probe saw no wrong solid but dBbox relative metric reached 8.2e-4 (abs 2 um), above the 3e-4 bar by the relative metric.
Over-refuses: 496 of 820 fuzz chains refused; gw1 turn4 refused though shipped was fine. Honest but costly.

notMeasured: k-pickguard 109-case sweep, r3-lumps, r3-magnitude, r3-slow not re-run (resource/time)
